workflow_rationale: Implement the /dev:rollback door to classify AI-driven changes (code-only, additive migration, destructive migration) and execute safe recovery strategies with human approval gates.

phases.name: Core Rollback Skill Implementation
phases.description: Create skills/rollback/SKILL.md implementing the classification engine, recovery strategies, two-branch synchronization, and human approval gates.

subtasks.description: Create skills/rollback/SKILL.md with change classification, remediation proposals, and audit trail generation
subtasks.notes: Define input resolution, diff inspection, 3-way classification (code-only, additive, destructive), human approval gate, dual-branch revert handling, and PR audit evidence.

phases.name: System Integration & Door Registration
phases.description: Register dev:rollback in shared/entry.md, SKILL.md, README.md, COMMANDS.md, and WORKFLOW.md.

subtasks.description: Register rollback in shared/entry.md and root SKILL.md
subtasks.notes: Add dev:rollback to input detection, single-word guard, sibling family table, and loading rules.

subtasks.description: Update documentation in README.md, COMMANDS.md, and WORKFLOW.md
subtasks.notes: Document usage examples, flags, classification outcomes, and update known gaps.

phases.name: Validation Suite & Test Scenarios
phases.description: Build test scenarios verifying classification, revert commit generation, additive migration proposals, destructive migration warnings, and PR audit trail.

subtasks.description: Validate code-only rollback flow with revert commit and PR audit trail

verification.instructions: Verify code-only scenario creates revert commit and records PR evidence trail

subtasks.notes: Test that code-only changes produce clean git revert and verification.

subtasks.description: Validate migration classification (additive vs destructive) and human approval guards

verification.instructions: Verify additive migration leaves schema forward and destructive migration warns & halts

subtasks.notes: Test schema classification rules and human pause.

subtasks.description: End-to-end rollback verification report across all acceptance criteria
subtasks.notes: Comprehensive validation report proving all 6 acceptance criteria met.

acceptance_criteria: Given a broken production deployment, when the developer runs /dev:rollback, then the system classifies the change as code-only, additive migration, or destructive migration
Given a code-only change, when rollback is executed, then a revert commit is created and verified before merge
Given an additive migration, when rollback is executed, then the system proposes backward-compatible remediation steps
Given a destructive migration, when rollback is executed, then the system warns about data implications and requires explicit confirmation
The rollback workflow pauses for human approval before executing any recovery action
A rollback evidence trail is recorded in the PR body for audit purposes

verification_steps.name: Integration Registration
verification_steps.expected_outcome: Rollback registered in entry and README

checks: Classification correctly detects code-only, additive, and destructive changes
PR evidence trail template is validated

qa_signoff.notes: All 6 acceptance criteria verified via unit/integration test suite and documented in ROLLBACK_VALIDATION.md.
